mapper.select: SELECT q.quota_id, q.grade, q.max_sessions, q.max_messages_per_period, q.period_days, q.reset_hour, q.reset_minute, q.quota_refund_enabled, q.updated_by, q.updated_at, u.nickname AS updater_nickname FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_GRADE_QUOTA q LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = q.updated_by ORDER BY q.quota_id

SELECT quota_id, grade, max_sessions, max_messages_per_period, period_days, reset_hour, reset_minute, quota_refund_enabled, updated_by, updated_at FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_GRADE_QUOTA WHERE grade = #{grade}
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_ASSISTANT_GRADE_QUOTA SET max_sessions = #{maxSessions}, max_messages_per_period = #{maxMessagesPerPeriod}, period_days = #{periodDays}, reset_hour = #{resetHour}, reset_minute = #{resetMinute}, quota_refund_enabled = #{quotaRefundEnabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE quota_id = #{quotaId}
